integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained after the published definition of \(p_0\). No numerical experiment, exhaustive search, independence claim, or external certification is used. A later 2025 finite-group phase-retrieval paper was identified as a residual literature risk because full text was not materially available, but its indexed scope does not state the zero-proportion formula.
scientific_limitations: Complex dimension two only. The theorem computes the support-zero invariant and sharp uniform linear-sampling threshold; it does not itself prove magnitude phase retrieval or classify optimal sample locations below the universal threshold.
title: Exact zero proportion for every two-dimensional finite-group orbit
